veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.voor: Die deur sou die hele week toe bly.
veranderings.na: Die deur sal die hele week toe bly.
veranderings.rede: The story is told in the present tense, so 'sal' fits better than the past-future 'sou'.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.voor: Nou lê die geld in sy sak en daar
veranderings.na: Nou lê die geld in sy sak, en daar
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.voor: is hy honger en hy sit alleen
veranderings.na: is hy honger en sit hy alleen
veranderings.rede: Repeating 'hy' before the verb sounds wooden; inversion after the shared opener reads naturally.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.voor: Zanele kom sit langs hom met haar kos.
veranderings.na: Zanele kom sit met haar kos langs hom.
veranderings.rede: Afrikaans puts manner before place, so 'met haar kos' comes before 'langs hom'.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.voor: breek haar brood in twee stukke en
veranderings.na: breek haar brood in twee en
veranderings.rede: 'In twee breek' is the idiom; 'stukke' followed by 'helfte' is redundant.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses; the protected 'brood met kaas' stays intact.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.voor: Thabang eet sy bord vol en daar bly
veranderings.na: Thabang eet 'n bord vol, en daar bly
veranderings.rede: 'Sy bord vol eet' is not idiomatic (one dishes a plate full or eats it empty); also adds the AWS clause comma.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.voor: is die kos nog koel teen die ys
veranderings.na: is die kos teen die ys nog koel
veranderings.rede: Placing 'teen die ys' before 'nog koel' makes clear it is the ice that keeps the food cool.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.voor: op die trappe en dit smaak goed
veranderings.na: op die trappe, en dit smaak goed
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.voor: op die veld en Thabang se keel
veranderings.na: op die veld, en Thabang se keel
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.voor: by die kraan en die water is
veranderings.na: by die kraan, en die water is
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.voor: lekkers en koeldrank en brood en
veranderings.rede: A list takes commas between items with only the last 'en'; the chain of 'en' reads clumsily.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.rede: 'Gaan staan' marks taking up a position, which clashes with 'n lang ruk'; plain 'staan' describes the lasting state.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.voor: Hy spoel dit uit en maak dit vol en sit
veranderings.na: Hy spoel dit uit, maak dit vol en sit
veranderings.rede: Three actions in a row read better as a list with a comma and one final 'en'.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.voor: gaan staan hy die eerste keer
veranderings.na: gaan staan hy vir die eerste keer
veranderings.rede: The idiom is 'vir die eerste keer'.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.blok: Die week toe die snoepie toe was
veranderings.voor: is die bord weg van die snoepie se deur af
veranderings.na: is die bord van die snoepie se deur af weg
veranderings.rede: In Afrikaans the predicate 'weg' naturally closes the clause after the 'van ... af' phrase.
